verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, and versioned service APIs with a deprecation policy are not a capability a processor ships, so this story's axis does not apply. The evidence mentions separate Intel software toolkits (oneAPI/oneDNN, OpenVINO) and an llms.txt file, but it documents no API versioning or deprecation policy for the product itself. The openapi probe returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
